result.summary: No critical visual breakage is apparent; the page renders like a normal food-delivery home feed. The main concerns are minor clipping/truncation in horizontally scrolling content and some low-contrast secondary text that may hurt readability.

issues.description: Items at the right edge are partially cut off, including the category row after “Healthy” and the “Trattoria Piccol…” card/title in “Fastest near you,” which can look unintentionally broken rather than clearly scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer carousel affordance such as edge fade, more consistent peek width, horizontal padding, or ensure titles truncate with ellipsis instead of being clipped by the viewport.

issues.description: Secondary text such as delivery fees, time estimates, and the search placeholder uses light gray on white/light backgrounds and may be hard to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Increase contrast of metadata and placeholder text to meet WCAG AA contrast guidance, or darken the gray used for secondary labels.

issues.description: The favorite heart controls are floating over busy food imagery with only a thin outline, making their hit target and state harder to perceive.
issues.suggestion: Give the favorite button a clearer background/selected state, larger touch target, and accessible label such as “Save Tokumaru Ramen Bar.”
